tonight's cookBeef cheeks braised with dried chillies, garlic and cumin until they shred, in warm corn tortillas with white onion, coriander, lime and a fierce salsa roja.Toast 4 dried guajillo chillies, soak in hot water for 20 minutes and blitz with 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and 400g crushed tomatoes.Brown 1kg beef cheeks, pour over the sauce with 500ml beef stock, cover and braise at 150°C for 4 hours.Shred in the sauce.For salsa roja, blitz 2 charred tomatoes, 2 chipotles in adobo and lime.Serve in 16 warm corn tortillas with diced white onion, coriander and lime.Main
